text.en:
Paragraph (g) of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and twenty-seven is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"(g) For the construction at Dipolog, Zamboanga, of the building of the Rizal Memorial Hospital . . . . . . . . . . .

Upon the completion of this building, the operation of the Rizal Memorial Hospital shall be
conducted therein with the property, funds and personnel of the present hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1928.
